dog.description_text: Meet Walter, a 9-year-old gentleman looking for a special person to give him the love and care he deserves! Walter is currently dealing with a skin condition that leaves him feeling uncomfortable, but he remains tolerant of gentle touch. This sweet senior boy will need an understanding and compassionate adopter who is willing to look beyond his current challenges and give him the patience, care, and support he needs to feel his best. Walter may need a little extra TLC, but he deserves the chance to enjoy his golden years surrounded by comfort, kindness, and love. He is looking for a special home with someone who understands that caring for a dog with medical needs takes commitment and patience. If you have room in your heart for a senior pup who needs someone in his corner, Walter may be the companion you've been waiting for!
dog.name: Walter
